calls: TENSION: Milan SS27 swings to the body (Prada lean/linear, pale skinny jeans and sheer trousers; D&G muscular; body-conscious knit). Paris stays soft. Ends the 'no contrary luxury signal' streak for relaxed pleated trousers. First seen in Run 02, set aside in Run 03. Hedge: relaxed through the leg, clean line, one lean option.
NEW: Toby by Hatem Alakeel (Saudi) shows a sports-luxe thobe line with sporty Arabesque embroidery. Decorative route, already crowded. Date, price and scale unverified.
NEW: Milan SS27 men's week thin on participation; presentations replacing shows (FashionUnited). Supports the quiet-launch method. Bain: Gulf luxury base -15-25% in H1 with Q2 recovery signs.
DISCARDED: Emirates Woman RFW 'third edition' article is Oct 2025, not 2026. RFW 2026: Oct 15-20, invite-only, ~30 designers, lineup still unpublished; menswear unconfirmed.
OPEN: RFW lineup, Cucinelli Q3 (Oct 15), Zegna Q3 (Oct 22), whether Loro Piana/Zegna/Cucinelli follow Prada's lean line, Toby details, ILLIYEEN, follower recount (fifth run without).
